description: This file defines the IndexInitializer class responsible for initializing, creating, and dropping indexes on MongoDB collections using reactive streams and Akka. It contains methods to handle index management tasks, including creating non-existing indexes, dropping undefined indexes, and interacting with the database via index operations.

classes.name: IndexInitializer
classes.description: A final class that manages index creation and removal on MongoDB collections using reactive streams and Akka for concurrency.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create an IndexInitializer instance with the given MongoDatabase and Materializer.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Main method to initialize indexes on a collection, creating non-existing indexes and removing undefined ones.

methods.name: createNonExistingIndices
methods.description: Creates indexes that do not exist on the collection, based on the provided list.

methods.name: createIndices
methods.description: Creates multiple indexes given a list.

methods.name: dropUndefinedIndices
methods.description: Drops indexes that are not defined in the provided list.

methods.name: getUndefinedIndexNames
methods.description: Returns a list of index names that are present in the database but not in the list of defined indexes.

methods.name: dropIndex
methods.description: Drops a single index by name.

methods.name: getIndicesExceptDefaultIndex
methods.description: Retrieves all indices except for the default _id_ index.

methods.name: extractIndexNames
methods.description: Extracts index names from a collection of Index objects.

methods.name: excludeIndices
methods.description: Filters out indices by name from a collection of all indices.
